written.title: Cyberpunk 2077's new update just made it the anti-GTA 6
written.description: What IGN, Kotaku, GamesRadar+ and VGC reported about Burger Shot and Vice City on 21 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Burger Shot and Vice City, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## IGN, 21 October 2026

[GTA 6's Fast Food Restaurant, Burger Shot, Is Coming to Real Life in the Miami Heat's Arena](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6s-fast-food-restaurant-burger-shot-is-coming-to-real-life-in-the-miami-heats-arena)

The outlet's own summary:

> One of the most iconic fast food restaurants from the GTA universe is becoming real ahead of GTA 6's release.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 GTA 6's Fast Food Restaurant, Burger Shot, Is Coming to Real Life in the Miami Heat's Arena Eat your heart out.

> Rockstar Games' takeover of Miami is continuing to expand with a real-life version of Burger Shot, a famous fast-food restaurant in the GTA franchise.

> In GTA, Burger Shot pokes fun at fast food joints like McDonald's and Burger King for their extremely unhealthy meals.

> In the game, Burger Shot has menu items like "The Heartstopper," which features seven patties stacked high between a variety of toppings.

> Miami's Kaseya Center has rebranded its burger restaurant as Burger Shot with Macca & Friends and Vice City posters also appearing inside the venue as part of #GTAVI's marketing campaign.

> Rockstar Games has other ambitious plans for the Kaseya Center, including an unprecdented regular season game where the Miami Heat will turn into the Vice City heat for one night on November 18.

> Rockstar has spent the last few weeks preparing for launch in Miami with extravagant marketing, which includes a $975,000 neon sign on top of the Kaseya Center that reads "Welcome to Vice City." Fans also recently spotted flashy GTA-branded sports cars driving around Miami .

## Kotaku, 21 October 2026

[Miami Man Who Posted Viral Video Of Vice City Ads Says He Was Fired: 'GTA 6 Cost Me My Job'](https://kotaku.com/miami-man-who-posted-viral-video-of-vice-city-ads-says-he-was-fired-gta-6-cost-me-my-job-2000748342)

The outlet's own summary:

> He allegedly got in trouble for leaking beach chairs

> Rockstar Games The marketing for Grand Theft Auto 6 is ramping up, and Miami is becoming more and more covered in advertisements for Vice City, the setting of Rockstar’s upcoming open-world sequel.

> He claims he was fired just for sharing an early look at the words “Vice City” plastered on some beach chairs.

> Earlier this month, video footage and screenshots began spreading on social media showing Vice City- and GTA 6 -branded chairs and umbrellas on a beach in Miami, Florida.

> The beach furniture is part of a larger marketing push, which also includes blimps and an NBA game, happening across the city that inspired Vice City.

## GamesRadar+, 22 October 2026

[Cyberpunk 2077's new update just made it the anti-GTA 6](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/cyberpunk/cyberpunk-2077s-new-update-just-made-it-the-anti-gta-6/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Night City over Vice City any day

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Even with its sprawling open world and all the painstaking technical details that have gone into protagonists Lucia and Jason's story, GTA 6 will never be among those we call the best RPGs .

> Some systems in the latest entry might hew close, but the way Jason and Lucia evolve are closer to being a sim than an RPG proper.

> Call me when Jason gets a gorilla arms mod (and don't tell Mommy on me).

> Games RPGs Cyberpunk Cyberpunk 2077's new update just made it the anti-GTA 6 Features By Jasmine Gould-Wilson Published 22 October 2026 4 min read Night City over Vice City any day When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission.

> Delivered in co-development with Virtuos Studios, the update brings new clothing items as well as long-awaited cyberware customization (courtesy of new NPC vendors called Glamdocs), and the opportunity to finally dual-wield any pistol or revolver combination.

> In the meantime, I'll take hot pink mantis blades, dual-wielding Jackie's golden pistols, and having cats in all of V's Night City apartments before Rockstar's precious new baby.

## VGC, 22 October 2026

[Rockstar is quietly transforming the real Miami into GTA 6’s Vice City | VGC](https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/rockstar-is-quietly-transforming-the-real-miami-into-gta-6s-vice-city/)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6’s in-universe branding, restaurants, cars, and more have been spotted around Miami…

> Inside the Kaseya Center, which is the arena where the Miami Heat play, visitors have spotted GTA’s in-universe fast food restaurants, Burger Shot and Cluckin’ Bell, having quietly opened inside.

> (via @luciacaminoss ) https://t.co/UhlpHkhUjl pic.twitter.com/zAJuZL4gkY - GTA 6 Countdown ⏳ (@GTAVI_Countdown) October 22, 2026 It’s beautiful 🤩 pic.twitter.com/dXJ6XiMHJQ - Joel Franco (@OfficialJoelF) October 18, 2026 The Burger Shot restaurant is reportedly a rebranded branch of burger chain Skinny Louie’s, with staff wearing new GTA 6-branded uniforms.

> The advertisements seen so far include spots for fictional TV station Weazel News, radio station Chamber 106.6, tech company Fruit, car company Coil, eCola, Y Hotel, Vault Nightclub, Big Chug, and more.

> Advertisements for Pißwasser and Patriot have been spotted outside bars in Miami, and a filing suggests they’ll soon sell the fictional beers.

> A real-life ‘Coquette’ (based on Chevrolet Corvette) has been seen driving with a Vice City wrap, alongside a Lamborghini wrapped in Vice Beach Police livery.

> Leonida will be divided into six main regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park, each offering a distinct setting inspired by different parts of Florida.

> Rockstar’s next open-world crime game is set across an entire fictionalized version of Florida, called Leonida, where the series is returning for the first time since 2006’s Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories.

> According to Rockstar, Grand Theft Auto VI will feature a more dynamic and localized weather system in Leonida, allowing different areas of the map to experience dramatically different conditions at the same time.

> The GTA 6 developer first signaled its intent to collaborate with the city of Miami – which the game’s fictional Vice City is based on – earlier this month.

> As part of Rockstar ’s announced promotion, NBA team Miami Heat is set to rebrand as ‘Vice City’ as part of an event dubbed “A Night In Vice City,” which will take place on the eve of GTA 6’s launch on November 18, when the Heat will take the court as “Vice City”.

> As part of the Miami Heat event, the team will play on a specially constructed “Vice City Court” and appear in a reimagined uniform.

> Special Vice City merchandise is also being sold at the Kaseya Center.

> Beyond Miami Heat, dozens of GTA 6 marketing promotions have been spotted around Miami so far, including a blimp, murals, Vice City branding on buses and taxis, and even in-universe marketing running on digital displays around the city.

> Notably, custom sports cars with Vice City number plates have been spotted driving around the city.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
